keyObservedDifference: 2014 had contemporaneously realized system-level market activity: Shanghai turnover had already reached a record before/around the access-rule change.
2013 IPO reform reopened a future underwriting channel but actual IPO issuance and fee realization had not yet occurred at the selection checkpoint.
IPO restart also had an explicit adverse secondary-market liquidity channel, making the net incidence less one-directional.

conclusions.strongestStatement: A pre-report market-structure selection likely needs not only a mechanical rule-to-company mapping, but also contemporaneous realized system-level flow/volume/usage evidence showing the new regime is already being used.
conclusions.productionDecision: Do not adopt V1 market-structure route into the production Skill.
